# Avalaible usages:

- Usage: make $command, available commands:
   - build ; Cleans and builds all targets defined by the makefile rules.
   - build=[hostname[/sketchbook-path] ; Builds all targets defined by the makefile rules, either locally or an accessible host. The default `sketchbook-path`=`~/gits`.
   - clean ; Removes all targets defined by the makefile rules.
   - gtest[=file] [argv="arg1 …"] ; Runs a given test CPP file with gdb.
   - show[=$port] ; Shows a local http:127.0.0.1:$port page, port=8080 by default.
   - start[=$port] ; Starts, if not yet done, a local http:127.0.0.1:$port server, port=8080 by default..
   - stop[=$port] ; Stops, if not yet done, a local http:127.0.0.1:$port server, port=8080 by default..
   - sync[=$message] ; Synchronizes files with respect to the github repositories.
   - test[=file] [argv="arg1 …"] ; Runs a given test file, if specified, or all src/test.* files.
   - usage ; Shows the makefile usage.
   - vtest[=file] [argv="arg1 …"] ; Runs a given test CPP file with valgrind.
- Usage: cleans [$directory] ; Cleans all known temporary files.
- Usage: git_sync $message ; Synchronizes with the current repository adding a commit message.
- Usage: md2html [$markdown-input [$markdown-output]]\n Renders a markdown input in html.
- Usage: subst $pattern $replacement [$input [$output]]\n Replaces a string using Javascript regular expressions, newline is treated as a standard char.
- Usage: urlexists $url ; Returns an empty string if the URL is available, else another request status.
- Usage: urlget $url [$file] ; Saves the url page in a file or stdout, if available, else echo the http status.
